Subject: Fwd: CloudForge SOW & DPA — internal positions and proposed language

Team — forwarding CF materials. Quick internal positions for discussion (call at 3pm):

1) Data retention: CF asks for 90 days of user-level logs in the SOW. We should propose 30 days standard, with the option to extend to 90 days by mutual agreement and documented justification (product reason + security controls). Rationale: lower retention reduces exposure and aligns with our default hosting profiles.

2) Subcontractor disclosure: CF wants unfettered subcontractor flow-down. Counter: ask for a list of named subprocessors and a requirement to notify Redwood of new subprocessors with a 30-day notice and obligation to enforce equivalent security terms.

3) SLA credits: CF's procurement proposes automatic credits for any latency > Xms. Suggest tightening to material outage definition (total downtime > 30 min / rolling 24h) and cap credits at 30% of monthly fees. We should avoid per-token credits for transient latency.

4) Audit rights: CF has asked for broad audit rights. Recommend granting SOC 2 report reviews and a narrow right to perform remote evidence reviews; for on-site audits require mutually agreed scope and cost sharing.

5) Timeline & product impact: If we accept significant retention or audit burdens, we need to push the launch by 2–3 weeks to complete engineering gating and infra hardening. That impacts revenue recognition and our Q4 targets.

Action items (pre-call): Vanessa to map procurement concessions and discount levers; Karthik to confirm technical feasibility of 30 vs 90 day retention; Marissa to calculate the revenue/timeline impact if launch shifts.

Neha

Adding procurement context from our side:

- CloudForge is a strategic ISV for us; there is clear upside in their GTM motion and a potential channel commitment. I can offer up to a 12% launch discount if we accept a negotiated extension on retention to 60 days instead of 90, and require a 90-day mutual review clause.
- Suggest a canary deployment clause: 30-day pilot with KPI gating (error rate < 1%, avg latency < 120ms) before full production acceptance. This protects both sides and keeps legal exposure limited during ramp.
- I'll attach procurement term sheet with suggested commercial language and discount schedule for quick review.

Attachment: Procurement-term-sheet.pdf

If Legal is comfortable with the proposed DPA adjustments, procurement can move to attach a one-time onboarding credit in the MSA to compensate engineering effort for sub-30 day retention encryption work.
